purpose: Resource qualification; original values retained; no scientific evaluation.

R1.gene1_gene2: Split exactly once on semicolon; preserve orientation.
R1.canonical_pair: Lexically sorted two original symbols separated by semicolon; added ID only.
R1.sens.score: Published sign-transformed GEMINI sensitive score; more negative = stronger adverse genetic interaction. Published zeros are real published values; never imputed.
R1.rank: Original publisher rank retained verbatim; never recomputed or used for selection.
R1.historical_threshold: sens.score <= -1, source-only label; all 547 PRKDC rows retained.
R1.replicate_or_guide_values: Absent from this CSV; design metadata in screen_metadata.csv.

field_semantics.target: Published perturbed gene string; exact identity join only; negative_control excluded from gene counts.
field_semantics.transcript: Published library-local transcript/TSS label. R2 varies by contrast. Equal labels across libraries do not verify genomic TSS identity.
field_semantics.sgID_AB: R3 original ordered dual-guide identifier; retain for duplicate target/transcript keys. ID text, not a sequence.
field_semantics.__original_index: Added name for R2 original unnamed column A, including pseudocontrol IDs.
field_semantics.score: Unaltered published phenotype; use the explicitly named rho or gamma group, not combined_score.
field_semantics.ttest pvalue: Published t-test P value; no new test computed.
field_semantics.BH adj_pvalue: Actual published BH-adjusted P value; present in both workbooks, not invented.
field_semantics.number_of_guide_elements: R2 per-row per-contrast count of guide elements; not replicate count.
field_semantics.combined_score: Publisher auxiliary composite, retained unchanged; not used instead of rho/gamma score.
field_semantics.label: Original non-hit, sensitivity/resistance, gamma fitness, or negative_control class. Blank stays blank.
field_semantics.rho: Drug endpoint relative to matched vehicle, except explicitly excluded R3 vehicle::rho:PRDX1KO_vs_parent, which is a genotype contrast.
field_semantics.gamma: Vehicle endpoint relative to T0 in the specified background.
field_semantics.tau: Treated endpoint relative to T0; not the requested contrast and not substituted.
field_semantics.normalization: R2 not growth normalized; R3 growth normalized. GEMINI, rho and gamma are not numerically interchangeable.

chosen_endpoints.R3_alternative_gamma: vehicle::gamma:parent_vs_T0 retained in raw/profiles; different published object and missingness, never used to fill parent::gamma blanks.

linked_score_panel.grain: One R1 PRKDC source row x one destination endpoint x one original destination record, plus explicit unmatched placeholders.
linked_score_panel.source_fields: gene_combination, sens.score and rank keep original names and exact strings.
linked_score_panel.destination_fields: Original second-level headers keep original names. condition stores exact first-level group. Raw Excel row and sgID_AB/original index identify each source record.
linked_score_panel.conversion: CSV fields preserve literal numeric OOXML <v> strings. No score rounding, normalization, averaging or favorable selection.
linked_score_panel.nulls: Blank score + destination_score_status distinguish missing published score from absent matched record. Never zero-fill.
linked_score_panel.excluded_objects: No KO, PARPi or PARPi combination endpoints in linked panel; complete source workbooks remain intact.
linked_score_panel.replicates: Published aggregate scores only. No fabricated replicate-level values.
linked_score_panel.expansion: R1-to-R3 one-to-many retained. Different endpoint groups are long rows, not a Cartesian product or independent samples.

qualified_support.grain: One original PRKDC pair/partner, all 547 retained.
qualified_support.finite_support: At least one finite original record for every specified endpoint; no choice among multiple records.
qualified_support.same_target_transcript: Within-library equality of published labels only, not verified guide-set identity.
qualified_support.eligibility: Coverage flags inform a later scientific lock; not biological success labels or a finalized inclusion protocol.

gene_identity_and_attribution.rule: Exact case-sensitive published strings; no fuzzy matches, external gene databases or automatic aliases.
gene_identity_and_attribution.unmatched: Preserved in crosswalk and support; reason unresolved, not assumed not-designed.
gene_identity_and_attribution.limits: No alias introduced to bridge absent promoter-pair names. No named flag on an exact symbol does not establish unambiguous biological attribution.

hidden_required_objects.bounded_join: No external workbook, author-held weights, raw screen reprocessing, predictor or model required.
unavailable_not_backfilled: R1/R2 constituent guide IDs and sequences
documented R2 per-condition transcript selection rule
hidden_required_objects.scope_limit: These absent objects prevent stronger claims or reconstruction; the supplied processed-score gene-symbol join does not require them.
